title: Claim-evidence integrity and conclusion eligibility
unit_of_analysis: declared v0.16 claim and audit gate
sample: 40 material claims, five evidence gates, and one conclusion-eligibility state
transformation: Read the five categorical gate states and conclusion-eligibility result for each mapped claim, preserve the states without assigning a numeric score, and render letter labels with shape and one blue accent.
claim_supported: Evidence fitness and dependency closure determine whether a traceable claim can enter a conclusion. The formal event-control rule and its bounded case-level results are eligible, while external venue readiness and independent validity remain ineligible.
prohibited_interpretation: The matrix supplies no aggregate trust score, source-truth determination, independent reliability estimate, or ranking of claims.
